records.context: ``search`` ``'exact'`` runs every bootstrap as the published analysis: double-precision fusion and a full resolution search. ``'fast'`` runs the resolution search on bootstrap 0 only, with 2 Leiden passes per step and one full run at the chosen resolution; the other bootstraps run Leiden once at that resolution with 2 passes, and the fusion is computed in single precision. Its partitions differ from the exact ones but met the published accuracy intervals on held-out plate A (about 10 times faster).
records.label: spacr.ops_clusters.pairs_bootstrap_consensus#2
records.source: ``search`` ``'exact'`` runs every bootstrap as the published analysis: double-precision fusion and a full resolution search. ``'fast'`` runs the resolution search on bootstrap 0 only, with 2 Leiden passes per step and one full run at the chosen resolution; the other bootstraps run Leiden once at that resolution with 2 passes, and the fusion is computed in single precision. Its partitions differ from the exact ones but met the published accuracy intervals on held-out plate A (about 10 times faster).
records.translation: ``search`` ``'exact'`` ejecuta cada bootstrap como el análisis publicado: fusión en doble precisión y una búsqueda completa de la resolución. ``'fast'`` ejecuta la búsqueda de la resolución solo en el bootstrap 0, con 2 pasadas de Leiden por paso y una ejecución completa en la resolución elegida; los demás bootstraps ejecutan Leiden una vez en esa resolución con 2 pasadas, y la fusión se calcula en precisión simple. Sus particiones difieren de las exactas, pero cumplieron los intervalos de precisión publicados en la placa A reservada (unas 10 veces más rápido).

records.translation: Cada fila dirigida extrae sus guías con reemplazo (``seed``; filas en orden, guías en el orden dado); una fila de control conserva sus guías. records.context: Each view's rows are scaled to unit length (a row of zeros gets a tiny constant first) and turned into a scaled exponential affinity on the Euclidean distance, with ``eps`` the mean of the two rows' mean distance to their ``neighbours`` nearest rows and their own distance. The full and the local (``neighbours`` nearest) transition matrices then cross-diffuse for ``iterations`` rounds, each view taking the mean of the others (Wang et al. 2014, Nat Methods), and the fused network is the symmetric mean of the views.
records.label: spacr.ops_clusters.snf_fuse#1
records.source: Each view's rows are scaled to unit length (a row of zeros gets a tiny constant first) and turned into a scaled exponential affinity on the Euclidean distance, with ``eps`` the mean of the two rows' mean distance to their ``neighbours`` nearest rows and their own distance. The full and the local (``neighbours`` nearest) transition matrices then cross-diffuse for ``iterations`` rounds, each view taking the mean of the others (Wang et al. 2014, Nat Methods), and the fused network is the symmetric mean of the views.
records.translation: Las filas de cada vista se escalan a longitud unitaria (una fila de ceros recibe antes una constante diminuta) y se convierten en una afinidad exponencial escalada sobre la distancia euclidiana, con ``eps`` la media de la distancia media de las dos filas a sus ``neighbours`` filas más cercanas y su propia distancia. Las matrices de transición completas y locales (``neighbours`` más cercanas) se difunden después de forma cruzada durante ``iterations`` rondas, tomando cada vista la media de las demás (Wang et al. 2014, Nat Methods), y la red fusionada es la media simétrica de las vistas.
